title: KVzip: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression with Context Reconstruction
authors: Jang-Hyun Kim; Jinuk Kim; Sangwoo Kwon; Jae W. Lee; Sangdoo Yun; Hyun Oh Song
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025, Oral)
affiliations: Seoul National University, Neural Processing Research Center, NAVER AI Lab
research_focus: KV cache compression, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: As context length grows, KV caches dominate memory and attention latency. Existing query-aware KV eviction methods (e.g. SnapKV, PyramidKV) score importance using the immediate query, so the compressed cache overfits the initial query: reusing it across diverse subsequent queries degrades accuracy even at a 90% cache budget, while re-prefilling per query is costly.
problem_statement.zh: 隨 context 長度增加，KV cache 佔用大量記憶體並拉高 attention 延遲。既有 query-aware KV 淘汰方法（如 SnapKV、PyramidKV）依當前 query 評估重要性，使壓縮後的 cache 過度貼合初始 query：跨多樣後續 query 重用時，即使 cache 預算高達 90% 仍出現明顯效能退化，而逐 query 重新 prefill 的成本又過高。

key_innovation.en: Query-agnostic KV eviction: each KV pair's importance is the maximum cross-attention it receives while the LLM reconstructs the original context from the cache via a repeat prompt in a single teacher-forced forward pass. Chunked scoring (2K-token chunks) reduces scoring cost from O(n_c^2) to linear O(m*n_c), and the same scores support both pair-level eviction and DuoAttention-style head-level context-independent eviction.
key_innovation.zh: Query-agnostic 的 KV 淘汰機制：以 LLM 透過 repeat prompt 從 cache 重建原始 context 的單次 teacher-forced forward pass，取每個 KV pair 收到的最大 cross-attention 作為重要性分數。Chunked scoring（2K token 分塊）將評分成本由 O(n_c^2) 降為線性 O(m*n_c)；同一組分數亦同時支援 pair-level 淘汰與 DuoAttention 式 head-level（context 無關）淘汰。

key_improvements.en: Reduces KV cache size by 3-4x and FlashAttention decoding latency by ~2x with negligible loss on QA, retrieval, reasoning, and code tasks up to 170K context; remains accurate up to 70% eviction where query-aware baselines degrade even at 10%; replaces DuoAttention's tens-of-GPU-hours head scoring with a few forward passes within a minute; with 4-bit KV quantization shrinks a 124K-token cache from 16.3 GB to 1.2 GB.
key_improvements.zh: 在 QA、檢索、推理與程式理解任務（context 最長 170K）上，KV cache 縮小 3-4x、FlashAttention decode 延遲約降 2x 且效能損失可忽略；淘汰比例達 70% 仍維持精度，而 query-aware 基線在 10% 淘汰即開始退化；DuoAttention 需數十 GPU-hours 的 head 評分被一分鐘內的少數 forward passes 取代；搭配 4-bit KV 量化可將 124K token 的 cache 由 16.3 GB 壓縮至 1.2 GB。
